info.title: Features Service API
info.description:
Manages feature definitions and computes output stats.

Features are a minimal lookup table: id, slug, name, description, status.
Stats are computed by calling downstream services and aggregating results.

salesFunnels.description: WHICH SALES FUNNELS THIS FEATURE MAY BE SOLD THROUGH, in brand-service's own funnel keys. A product statement about the feature, owned by this service: the dashboard offers only valid (funnel, feature) pairs from it and campaign-service refuses to provision a pair that is not in it. ALWAYS PRESENT, so an absent answer can never be mistaken for 'all of them' — a feature that sells through no sales funnel states `[]` (every non-sales feature: PR, hiring, VC, accelerators, AI visibility, press kit, outlet discovery, expert quotes) and one that sells through every declared funnel states every one of those keys explicitly. A shorter list is a real restriction, not a gap: the feedback-request cold email states `sales_meetings_from_conversation` alone, because its offer buys a conversation and has no website step to sell.

channelType.description: WHAT KIND of channel this feature is — the ONE typology (owner 2026-10-09), stated on EVERY feature, active and deprecated: `sourcing`, `outbound`, `conversion`, `paid`, `earned`, `pr`, `fundraising`, `hiring`, `tool` (not a channel: scoring, page generation, outlet discovery). A surface groups or excludes features by this, never by whether `acquisitionChannel` is null and never by a slug list of its own. Supersedes the acquisition channel's `family`.

supersededBySlug.description: THE SLUG THAT REPLACED THIS ONE, or null when this slug is the current one. A retired slug is never renamed or deleted — live campaigns, live budgets and the cost ledger reference it, so this row and every per-brand and per-campaign read of it keep working exactly as before. What retirement changes is one thing only: the slug stops being PUBLISHED, so the public acquisition-channel catalogue (and the per-pair economics built from it) lists the offering once, under the current spelling. A consumer offering a customer something new should offer the successor.

roiMultiple.description: The EXPECTED return, never null unless unavailableReason. = the scope's own MATURE return when it has one (basis measured), else its sales path's ROI exactly as GET /offers/{offerId}/sales-paths prices it: lifetime revenue / cost per paying client, each leg's rate measured > stated > fleet median > industry default, each leg's cost best mature workflow > fleet measured > seeded default, the offer's stated lifetime revenue else the fleet median. Additive: costEconomics.roiMultiple and its maturity verdict are unchanged.

basis.description: What an expected figure rests on, the WEAKEST of its inputs: measured (the scope's own mature evidence / a measured rate / our own workflow's mature cost) < stated (the customer stated it: a leg rate, the offer's lifetime revenue) < fleet (the fleet median / the fleet's measured cost) < default (a seeded industry benchmark or cost). A tooltip says it in words.

legKey.description: The leg a rate or a cost is about. Null otherwise.

basis.description: What an expected figure rests on, the WEAKEST of its inputs: measured (the scope's own mature evidence / a measured rate / our own workflow's mature cost) < stated (the customer stated it: a leg rate, the offer's lifetime revenue) < fleet (the fleet median / the fleet's measured cost) < default (a seeded industry benchmark or cost). A tooltip says it in words.

source.description: The producer's own word: crm_measured | measured_on_our_leads | customer_stated | fleet_median | industry_default (rate); workflow | fleet_measured | default | benchmark (cost); offer_stated | fleet_median (lifetime_revenue); not_running (sales_path: the offer runs no funnel campaign, so the figure is the best path we would sell it).

assumptions.description: Every input the model figure rests on, with its own source. Empty on a measured figure.

combinationKey.description: The sales path (combination key, stored spelling) the figure is read off. A funnel campaign reads its OWN (its sourcing legs dropped: a path counts from Lead found; the listed path, else its own legs priced on the same rates and costs; a reactive funnel on the value it adds over what its people were already worth at the trigger step), never the offer's: unpriceable = null + own_sales_path_unpriced; a campaign the best selected path running it; an offer its best selected path (proactive first); a brand its best offer. Null on a measured figure.

stepKey.description: The outcome the cost buys (the leg's TO step), e.g. conversation (a positive reply) or website_visit.

basis.description: What an expected figure rests on, the WEAKEST of its inputs: measured (the scope's own mature evidence / a measured rate / our own workflow's mature cost) < stated (the customer stated it: a leg rate, the offer's lifetime revenue) < fleet (the fleet median / the fleet's measured cost) < default (a seeded industry benchmark or cost). A tooltip says it in words.

costPerOutcome.description: The EXPECTED cost per outcome of the scope's leg on that path (a campaign's own leg; an offer's, funnel's or brand's first platform leg). Always the model's figure, also beside a measured return. Null on a path whose legs carry no platform cost.

unavailableReason.description: Why roiMultiple is null: the model could not be read (logged), is computing for the first time since a deploy (served on the next read), no path could be priced, or a funnel campaign's OWN path cannot be priced (a leg with no rate or no platform cost, e.g. a leads-only funnel: never another funnel's figure).

ExpectedReturn.description: THE EXPECTED RETURN (owner 2026-10-11: every ROI surface always reads a value, even expected, on a stated hypothesis). See roiMultiple.

ratePct.description: The row's EXPECTED % Conversion, never null except on Paid client (nothing converts past it) or unavailableReason. = conversionFromRowAbove.ratePct when measured, else the brand's effective rate of the leg out of the row's step on the offer's priced paths (GET /brands/{brandId}/conversion-rates: measured > stated > fleet median > industry default; the shallowest next step); the contacted row: the entry leg's fleet conversion, else a seeded cold-email benchmark (1% positive reply, 2% website visit).

basis.description: What an expected figure rests on, the WEAKEST of its inputs: measured (the scope's own mature evidence / a measured rate / our own workflow's mature cost) < stated (the customer stated it: a leg rate, the offer's lifetime revenue) < fleet (the fleet median / the fleet's measured cost) < default (a seeded industry benchmark or cost). A tooltip says it in words.

source.description: measured | manual | default (the effective rate's own source; median retired 2026-10-14) | fleet_measured | default_entry.

toStep.description: The step the rate leads to (the row above when measured).

legKey.description: The leg the hypothesis is read off. Null when measured.

ExpectedConversion.description: THE EXPECTED % CONVERSION (owner 2026-10-11: a conversion rate is never empty, on a stated hypothesis). Additive beside conversionFromRowAbove (unchanged).

durationDays.description: How many days before today (UTC midnight) a run must have STARTED for its spend, and the leads it served, to count as MATURE. 21 on the two cold-email entry legs (a run's positive replies and visits keep arriving for weeks; 21 days captures 92-95% of them, measured in prod 2026-09-28); 0 on every other leg, whose mature figure is therefore its flash figure.

outcomesRequired.description: How many MATURE outcomes of the leg's step a scope must hold to be judged mature: 1 positive reply on start_to_conversation, 10 website visits on start_to_website_visit, 10 on every other leg.

outcomeSignal.description: The counted signal the leg's outcome IS on an entry leg (a website visit is a click, a conversation is a positive reply). Null on every other leg, whose outcome is walked from a driver signal.

source.description: `measured` = the owner set this rule from production evidence; `default` = no leg-specific rule was measured, so the leg is mature the day it is bought and judged on the pre-existing bar of 10.

LegMaturityRule.description: ONE LEG'S MATURITY RULE. Every figure exists in two versions: FLASH (everything to date) and MATURE (the spend of runs started more than durationDays ago, over the outcomes — whenever they land — of the leads those runs served). One clock for both: the run start, i.e. the serve.

spentUsd.description: Committed spend on the request's pricing basis, summed exactly (never rounded per group), so a scope's rows add up to the scope. Null ONLY on the staff actual-cost twin, where this grain's spend on this version holds rows with no known vendor cost.

outcomes.description: The leg's own outcomes (on an entry leg, distinct leads at its outcome signal).

costPerOutcomeUsd.description: spentUsd / outcomes — OBSERVED, never floored. Null at 0 outcomes or 0 spend (and on the actual-cost twin where the vendor cost is unknown).

conversionRatePct.description: 100 × outcomes / contacted. Null only at 0 contacted; a measured 0 stays 0.

OutcomeFigures.description: The observed figures of one scope on one version (flash or mature).

legKey.description: The leg these figures and this rule are for.

allOf.description: Everything to date.

The runs started before the cutoff and the leads THOSE runs served (their outcomes whenever they landed). A cohort that was read and holds nothing is all zeros; null ONLY when the cut could not be made (legs unknown, serve dates not stated).

isMature.description: mature.outcomes >= outcomesRequired. Null = could not judge; never a Learning verdict.

LegMaturityFigures.description: ONE LEG of a scope on both bases, with the leg's own rule (LegMaturityRule) beside its figures.

isMature.description: The scope's verdict: mature when EVERY leg present in its mature figures (mature spend or mature leads) is mature. A scope with activity and no leg present yet is young: false. Null = could not judge (serve dates not stated, legs unreadable, or nothing to judge) — a consumer shows the mature value if any, else a dash, and no Learning tag.

legs.description: One entry per leg the scope's campaigns are bought for whose outcome is a counted signal (a campaign stating no leg, and the AI meeting-booking leg, carry none).

ScopeMaturity.description: THE SCOPE'S MATURITY — the byte-same object every surface describing this scope serves (/revenue, audience rows, offer outcomes, /stats), so a consumer can reconcile them. features-service#1196.

flash.description: Everything to date. Null when there is no flash figure at all.

mature.description: The mature cohort's figure. NULL when the mature cut could not be made. A cut that was made and holds nothing states that instead: zeros on observed figures, null fields on a resolved price.

isMature.description: The verdict: at least the leg's outcomesRequired MATURE outcomes. Null = the mature outcomes could not be counted, never a verdict.

CostRatiosMaturity.description: The three ratios on BOTH bases, beside the scope's verdict (features-service#1196). OBSERVED — never a floor: null at 0 outcomes. Display `mature`; `flash` is available for staff.

flash.description: Everything to date. Null when there is no flash figure at all.

mature.description: The mature cohort's figure. NULL when the mature cut could not be made. A cut that was made and holds nothing states that instead: zeros on observed figures, null fields on a resolved price.

isMature.description: The verdict: at least the leg's outcomesRequired MATURE outcomes. Null = the mature outcomes could not be counted, never a verdict.

SpendRatiosMaturity.description: Every cost per outcome of the spend block on BOTH bases, beside the scope's verdict (features-service#1196). OBSERVED — never a floor: null at 0 outcomes. Display `mature`; `flash` is available for staff.

flash.description: Everything to date. Null when there is no flash figure at all.

mature.description: The mature cohort's figure. NULL when the mature cut could not be made. A cut that was made and holds nothing states that instead: zeros on observed figures, null fields on a resolved price.

isMature.description: The verdict: at least the leg's outcomesRequired MATURE outcomes. Null = the mature outcomes could not be counted, never a verdict.

OutcomeRatiosMaturity.description: The two per-lead costs on BOTH bases, beside the scope's verdict (features-service#1196). OBSERVED — never a floor: null at 0 outcomes. Display `mature`; `flash` is available for staff.

flash.description: Everything to date. Null when there is no flash figure at all.

mature.description: The mature cohort's figure. NULL when the mature cut could not be made. A cut that was made and holds nothing states that instead: zeros on observed figures, null fields on a resolved price.

isMature.description: The verdict: at least the leg's outcomesRequired MATURE outcomes. Null = the mature outcomes could not be counted, never a verdict.

ConversionRateMaturity.description: The scope's conversion on BOTH bases, beside the scope's verdict (features-service#1196). OBSERVED — never a floor: null at 0 outcomes. Display `mature`; `flash` is available for staff.

flash.description: Everything to date. Null when there is no flash figure at all.

mature.description: The mature cohort's figure. NULL when the mature cut could not be made. A cut that was made and holds nothing states that instead: zeros on observed figures, null fields on a resolved price.

isMature.description: The verdict: at least the leg's outcomesRequired MATURE outcomes. Null = the mature outcomes could not be counted, never a verdict.

AudienceMetricsMaturity.description: This audience's own cost columns — spend attributed by the run's audience tag, people by the audience lead-service froze on the serve on BOTH bases, beside the scope's verdict (features-service#1196). OBSERVED — never a floor: null at 0 outcomes. Display `mature`; `flash` is available for staff.

flash.description: Everything to date. Null when there is no flash figure at all.

mature.description: The mature cohort's figure. NULL when the mature cut could not be made. A cut that was made and holds nothing states that instead: zeros on observed figures, null fields on a resolved price.

isMature.description: The verdict: at least the leg's outcomesRequired MATURE outcomes. Null = the mature outcomes could not be counted, never a verdict.

AudienceProjectionMaturity.description: The projection priced from this audience's OBSERVED unit costs through the same funnel on BOTH bases, beside the scope's verdict (features-service#1196). OBSERVED — never a floor: null at 0 outcomes. Display `mature`; `flash` is available for staff.

flash.description: Everything to date. Null when there is no flash figure at all.

mature.description: The mature cohort's figure. NULL when the mature cut could not be made. A cut that was made and holds nothing states that instead: zeros on observed figures, null fields on a resolved price.

isMature.description: The verdict: at least the leg's outcomesRequired MATURE outcomes. Null = the mature outcomes could not be counted, never a verdict.

OfferOutcomeMaturity.description: The return and cost per outcome (a row's verdict: the multi-leg rule over its legs) on BOTH bases, beside the scope's verdict (features-service#1196). OBSERVED — never a floor: null at 0 outcomes. Display `mature`; `flash` is available for staff.

totalCostInUsdCents.description: COMMITTED run cost (USD cents) — billed `actual` PLUS the open `provisioned` holds. The canonical 'Total spent' and the numerator behind every cost-per-X stat on this response, so cost-per metrics reconcile with the displayed spend AND with /revenue's ROI. features-service serves EXACTLY ONE spend basis and it is COMMITTED (billed `actual` + the open `provisioned` holds). A split basis was a bug, not a tradeoff: while ROI rode billed-only and the `spend` block rode committed, one payload answered 'how much did this cost' two ways at once and a brand with a single campaign read $202 on its Overview beside $191 on its campaigns table. Do NOT reintroduce a second basis and do NOT add a parameter to pick one. (features-service#779)

actualCostInUsdCents.description: Billed-only run spend (USD cents) — excludes provisioned holds + cancelled reservations. REPORTED ONLY; no cost-per-X stat divides by it. (features-service#396, single basis features-service#779)

key.description: Stable identity key. Opaque — compare it, do not parse it.

acquisitionChannel.description: The channel it acquires through, e.g. cold_email.

campaignIds.description: Every campaign id answering to this identity, this one included.

liveCampaignIds.description: The members still ongoing — at most one.

representativeId.description: The member to render the identity's line on: the live campaign when there is one, else the most recently created member.

campaignIdentity.description: Present only on groupBy=campaignId: the identity these figures were totalled over. Every member of one identity carries the SAME figures — they are one campaign.

costBasis.description: ACCOUNTING — every money figure on this response is what the customer was CHARGED. Spend the platform COMPED (refunded after the fact) is absent from it: they did not pay it. This is the opposite of the CROSS-ORG PERFORMANCE benchmark (/public/stats/* and the crossOrg grain of /workflow-projection), which shares the words "spend" and "cost per outcome" but counts comped spend at full value, because what a workflow costs to produce an outcome does not depend on whether we billed it. ORTHOGONAL to ?pricing=gross|net, which is a DISCOUNT question, not a comped one.

offerId.description: WHICH offer this channel is being started for — the offer whose confirmed fields ground the extraction. The user-facing inputs describe ONE value proposition, so a brand selling two things has two right answers and only the caller knows which it means. OPTIONAL: omit it and a brand with a single offer behaves exactly as before, while a brand holding SEVERAL answers 409 `several_offers` (carrying the offers) until one is named. An id naming no offer of this brand is a 404. Never defaulted here, and never resolved to 'the first offer'.

days.description: The window's length in UTC days, the last one being today (echo of ?windowDays=).

startDate.description: First UTC day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD.

endDate.description: Last UTC day of the window (today), YYYY-MM-DD.

sent.description: EMAILS sent over the window, every step (not leads). Σ daily[].sent.

delivered.description: Emails delivered over the window. Σ daily[].delivered.

bounced.description: Emails bounced over the window, on the day each bounced. Σ daily[].bounced.

deliveryRatePct.description: delivered ÷ sent × 100 over the window. Null when nothing was sent (or the counts contradict), never 0.
That day's delivered ÷ sent × 100; null on a day nothing was sent.

daily.description: One entry per day of the window, ascending, zero-filled. Each number is email-gateway's own for the day the event happened, so a day's delivered need not equal its sent − bounced.

emails.description: The scope's emails, from email-gateway's per-day email stats (the same read `sequences` rides). Null when that read failed — never a zero.

actualSpentCents.description: ACTUAL (charged) spend over the window, USD cents, on the read's ?pricing= basis: the scope's campaigns PLUS the brand's own work no campaign carries (setup, notifications) — the composition of spend.actualSpentTodayCents on the same read. Σ daily[].actualSpentCents, exactly. On the CAMPAIGN read (/features/{featureSlug}/revenue?campaignId=&windowDays=) it is the campaign identity's own spend only (its stopped ancestors included, no brand-level work), and actualSpentCents / totalSpentCents / provisionedSpentCents ARE the same body's spend block figures (totalSpentCents = costEconomics.committedCostUsd × 100) while daily[] stays rounded per day, so on that read Σ daily may differ from the total by a few cents, so brandLevel* are 0 there.

brandLevelActualSpentCents.description: The part of actualSpentCents no campaign carries (the brand's own setup work, notifications). On an offer of a brand selling several offers, every offer shows it. Always 0 on the campaign read (a campaign carries none of it). Σ daily[].brandLevelActualSpentCents.

costPerEmailSentCents.description: actualSpentCents ÷ emails.sent over the window (fractional cents). Null when nothing was sent, or when emails is null.

totalSpentCents.description: COMMITTED spend over the window, USD cents, same ?pricing= basis and composition as actualSpentCents (scope's campaigns + the brand's campaign-less work): what was charged PLUS the holds still open for runs still working (runs' total cost). The figure a "Spent" tile states. Σ daily[].totalSpentCents, exactly.

provisionedSpentCents.description: totalSpentCents − actualSpentCents: the holds still open on runs started in the window. Σ daily[].provisionedSpentCents.

brandLevelTotalSpentCents.description: The committed part no campaign carries (setup, notifications). Σ daily[].brandLevelTotalSpentCents.

totalCostPerEmailSentCents.description: totalSpentCents ÷ emails.sent over the window (fractional cents), the committed twin of costPerEmailSentCents. Null when nothing was sent, or when emails is null.

actualSpentCents.description: That day's actual spend (runs started that UTC day), rounded once to whole cents.

totalSpentCents.description: That day's committed spend (actual + open holds, runs started that UTC day), rounded once to whole cents.

daily.description: One entry per day of the window, ascending, zero-filled.

spend.description: Dated by runs-service's own day buckets (run start, UTC). Null when that read failed — never a zero.

total.description: Σ daily[].count, exactly.

date.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD.

cumulativeCount.description: Running total: Σ count from the window's first day through this day (on ?windowDays=all, since inception). Non-decreasing; the last day's value IS total, so a cumulative curve ends on the printed figure without the consumer summing anything.

daily.description: One entry per day of the window, ascending, zero-filled.

recipientsRepliesPositive.description: People whose FIRST positive reply landed on a day of the window — the body's own recipientsRepliesPositive.daily, summed over the window. An undated reply sits on no day and is in no window.

total.description: Σ daily[].count, exactly.

date.description: UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD.

cumulativeCount.description: Running total: Σ count from the window's first day through this day (on ?windowDays=all, since inception). Non-decreasing; the last day's value IS total, so a cumulative curve ends on the printed figure without the consumer summing anything.

daily.description: One entry per day of the window, ascending, zero-filled.

recipientsClicked.description: People whose FIRST website visit landed on a day of the window — the body's own recipientsClicked.daily, summed over the window.

totalPipelineUsd.description: == headline.totalPipelineUsd on the same body (the EXPECTED pipeline).

undatedPipelineUsd.description: Pipeline in the headline whose organisation carries no event date, so it sits on no day. 0 whenever every organisation is dated, in which case the last daily point IS the headline.

cumulativePipelineUsd.description: Expected pipeline of every organisation dated on or before the end of this day (cumulative since the brand began, not since the window began).

daily.description: One entry per day of the window, ascending. Same basis as the headline (the expected pipeline, every lead to date), so the curve ends at the headline. NOT roiHistory's pipeline leg, which is the realized, mature cohort's.

expectedPipeline.description: Null when the headline pipeline is null (no funnel, cold start).

queuedEmails.description: EMAILS (every step of a sequence, the same grain as emails.sent/delivered/bounced) of the scope's campaigns that are scheduled and not yet sent RIGHT NOW, read from the sender's own queue (email-gateway broadcast emailStats.queued, relayed from instantly-service; live sequences only: a paused, stopped, completed, replied, bounced or unsubscribed sequence's steps are not queued). A current SNAPSHOT, not a window figure: the same value whatever ?windowDays= asks, and it sits on no day. 0 = nothing waiting (measured). Null with queuedEmailsUnavailableReason when it could not be read, never 0.

queuedEmailsUnavailableReason.description: Why queuedEmails is null; null whenever queuedEmails is a number. sender_queue_unreadable = the sending service said it could not read its queue; stats_unreadable = the email-gateway read failed or did not carry the count.

costBasis.description: ACCOUNTING — every money figure on this response is what the customer was CHARGED. Spend the platform COMPED (refunded after the fact) is absent from it: they did not pay it. This is the opposite of the CROSS-ORG PERFORMANCE benchmark (/public/stats/* and the crossOrg grain of /workflow-projection), which shares the words "spend" and "cost per outcome" but counts comped spend at full value, because what a workflow costs to produce an outcome does not depend on whether we billed it. ORTHOGONAL to ?pricing=gross|net, which is a DISCOUNT question, not a comped one.

key.description: Stable identity key. Opaque — compare it, do not parse it.

acquisitionChannel.description: The channel it acquires through, e.g. cold_email.

campaignIds.description: Every campaign id answering to this identity, this one included.

liveCampaignIds.description: The members still ongoing — at most one.

representativeId.description: The member to render the identity's line on: the live campaign when there is one, else the most recently created member.

campaignIdentity.description: Present only on a ?campaignId= read: the identity the figures were totalled over. A campaign-scoped read answers for the campaign's whole identity — its stopped ancestors included — so asking about any member returns the same, complete campaign.

allOf.description: Present ONLY on a ?campaignId= read that asked ?windowDays= (windowDays=all = since inception): the campaign card row. The SAME block the offer and brand revenue reads serve, over the campaign's whole IDENTITY (its stopped ancestors included) on this channel: emails sent / delivered / bounced (EMAILS, every step), emails queued right now (queuedEmails, snapshot), and spend on the read's ?pricing= basis as actualSpentCents (charged) + provisionedSpentCents (holds still open, e.g. follow-ups not sent yet) = totalSpentCents (committed). The spend is the campaign's own only (brandLevel* are 0). A part that could not be read is null (queuedEmails with queuedEmailsUnavailableReason), never 0. See RevenueWindow.

totalSpentCents.description: 'Total spent' (COMMITTED, USD cents) = ACTUAL + PROVISIONED holds for the brand(+campaign)+feature, == Σ sources[].totalSpentCents. The reserved money the customer sees; dips when a hold releases. Reconciles with totalCpcCents by construction.

actualSpentCents.description: Billed-only spend (USD cents), == Σ sources[].actualSpentCents. Same source as systemStats.actualCostInUsdCents / costEconomics.actualCostUsd. REPORTED ONLY — ROI/CAC and every cost-per-outcome column ride the COMMITTED totalSpentCents beside it.

provisionedSpentCents.description: Open PROVISIONED holds only (USD cents) = totalSpentCents − actualSpentCents, == Σ sources[].provisionedSpentCents. Money reserved for scheduled follow-up sends, not yet billed.

totalSpentTodayCents.description: COMMITTED spend (actual + provisioned, USD cents) for runs started since 00:00 UTC today — 'Budget spent today'. On the OFFER and BRAND grains (/offers/{offerId}/revenue, /brands/{brandId}/revenue) it also counts the brand's own work no campaign carries (setting the brand up, notification emails), on every channel: what was charged for this brand today. Every other read: the scope's own runs only.

actualSpentTodayCents.description: ACTUAL (billed) spend (USD cents) for runs started since 00:00 UTC today. On the OFFER and BRAND grains it also counts the brand's own work no campaign carries (setting the brand up, notification emails), so it equals runs-service's actual spend for the brand since 00:00 UTC (to per-group cent rounding); an offer of a brand selling several offers shares that part with them. Every other read: the scope's own runs only.

provisionedSpentTodayCents.description: Open PROVISIONED holds (USD cents) = totalSpentTodayCents − actualSpentTodayCents, for runs started since 00:00 UTC today.

source.description: runs-service cost name (billable line item, e.g. 'apollo people-search', 'email-send-step-1').

totalSpentCents.description: COMMITTED spend attributed to this source (actual + provisioned holds), USD cents. Σ over sources == spend.totalSpentCents.

actualSpentCents.description: ACTUAL (billed) spend attributed to this source, USD cents. Σ over sources == spend.actualSpentCents.

provisionedSpentCents.description: Open PROVISIONED holds attributed to this source (= totalSpentCents − actualSpentCents), USD cents. Σ over sources == spend.provisionedSpentCents.

sharePct.description: This source's share of the COMMITTED total (spend.totalSpentCents), percent (0–100). 0 when the committed total is 0.

sources.description: Per cost-name committed/actual/provisioned spend + committed share-of-total, descending — the 'top cost sources' list pre-computed (the dashboard renders verbatim instead of summing the runs breakdown in the browser).

totalCpcCents.description: COMMITTED cost per website click = totalSpentCents / clicks (clicked.total). Null (renders '-'), never a false $0.00, when there are 0 clicks OR 0 committed spend.

actualCpcCents.description: ACTUAL (billed) cost per website click = actualSpentCents / clicks. Null (renders '-'), never a false $0.00, when 0 clicks OR 0 actual spend.

provisionedCpcCents.description: PROVISIONED cost per website click = provisionedSpentCents / clicks. Null (renders '-'), never a false $0.00, when 0 clicks OR 0 provisioned holds.

signupsCount.description: REAL attributed signups (lead-service conversion tracker, deduped, excludes 'ping') for the brand — the Signups tile. 0 when none. ABSENT (undefined) on a cold / pre-rollout payload when lead-service didn't serve the counts; never a fabricated 0. (features-service#461)

salesMeetingsCount.description: REAL attributed sales meetings booked (lead-service conversion tracker) for the brand — the Sales Meetings tile. 0 when none. ABSENT on a cold / pre-rollout payload; never a fabricated 0.

formSubmissionsCount.description: REAL attributed form submissions (lead-service conversion tracker, event=form_submission, deduped, excludes 'ping') for the brand — the Form Submissions tile for a form_submissions brand (the visit-driven sibling of signups). 0 when none. ABSENT on a cold / pre-rollout payload when lead-service didn't serve the counts; never a fabricated 0.

cpsCents.description: REAL cost per signup = totalSpentCents (COMMITTED = actual + provisioned, the SAME denominator as totalCpcCents) / signupsCount, USD cents. So cpsCents × signupsCount ≈ committed spend by construction. null when signupsCount is 0 (no denominator — never a false $0). ABSENT when signupsCount is absent. REPLACES the projected cps dropped in features-service#406 with the REAL tracked computation — no projection.

cpsmCents.description: REAL cost per sales meeting = totalSpentCents (COMMITTED) / salesMeetingsCount, USD cents. null when salesMeetingsCount is 0. ABSENT when salesMeetingsCount is absent. Real tracked data, not a projection.

cpfsCents.description: REAL cost per form submission = totalSpentCents (COMMITTED, SAME denominator as cpsCents/totalCpcCents) / formSubmissionsCount, USD cents. So cpfsCents × formSubmissionsCount ≈ committed spend by construction. null when formSubmissionsCount is 0 (no denominator — never a false $0). ABSENT when formSubmissionsCount is absent. Real tracked data, not a projection.

salesCount.description: REAL attributed SALES — paying clients won (lead-service conversion tracker, event=sale, RENAMED from event=purchase, deduped, excludes 'ping') for the brand — the Sales tile's brand-level aggregate, the terminal outcome of BOTH the website-purchase goal (multi-step close) and the combined-sales goal (paying client won via either path). Equivalent to signupsCount / salesMeetingsCount / formSubmissionsCount. 0 when none; ABSENT on a cold / pre-rollout payload when lead-service didn't serve the counts; never a fabricated 0. (Renamed from purchasesCount — features-service combined-sales slice.)

cpSaleCents.description: REAL cost per sale = totalSpentCents (COMMITTED, SAME denominator as cpsCents/totalCpcCents) / salesCount, USD cents. So cpSaleCents × salesCount ≈ committed spend by construction. null when salesCount is 0 (no denominator — never a false $0). ABSENT when salesCount is absent. Real tracked data, not a projection. (Renamed from cppCents — features-service combined-sales slice.)

positiveRepliesCount.description: REAL attributed positive replies for the brand — the single-step positive_replies goal's outcome (reply-goal sibling of signups/meetings/form-submissions), the Positive Replies tile. Deduped by lead from the SAME leads[] snapshot as recipientsRepliesPositive.total (a positive reply is an email engagement signal, NOT a lead-service conversion event), so ALWAYS present (leads are a fail-loud core input) — never absent, unlike the conversion-counts tiles. 0 when none. (features-service#482)

cpprCents.description: REAL cost per positive reply = totalSpentCents (COMMITTED = actual + provisioned, the SAME denominator as totalCpcCents/cpsCents) / positiveRepliesCount, USD cents. So cpprCents × positiveRepliesCount ≈ committed spend by construction. null when positiveRepliesCount is 0 (no denominator — never a false $0). Real tracked data, not a projection. (features-service#482)

maturityDays.description: The maturity delay the ratios were measured under — costEconomics.maturityDays.

committedSpentCents.description: COMMITTED spend every committed ratio above divides (totalCpcCents, cpprCents, cpsCents, cpsmCents, cpfsCents, cpSaleCents): the mature cohort's when maturityDays > 0, totalSpentCents otherwise. Equals costEconomics.ratioBasis.committedCostUsd × 100.

actualSpentCents.description: Billed spend actualCpcCents divides, on the same basis.

provisionedSpentCents.description: Open holds provisionedCpcCents divides, on the same basis.

clicksCount.description: Website visits the CPCs divide: the mature cohort's visitors when maturityDays > 0.

positiveRepliesCount.description: Positive replies cpprCents divides, on the same basis.

signupsCount.description: Signups cpsCents divides. On a matured basis read off the cohort's own leads (lead-service's counts are undated). ABSENT when the top-level count is.

salesMeetingsCount.description: Meetings booked cpsmCents divides, same rules.

formSubmissionsCount.description: Form submissions cpfsCents divides, same rules.

unmeasuredReason.description: Why every ratio above is null: maturing = nothing spent is mature yet; maturity_unknown = campaign legs unreadable. Spend and counts here are null too.

ratioBasis.description: WHAT EVERY COST PER OUTCOME IN THIS BLOCK DIVIDES — the ROI's own basis, so the ratios and costEconomics.roiMultiple are one basis on one screen. Each ratio = the matching spend here ÷ the matching count here (outside the zero-outcome benchmark floor). The block's top-level totals and counts keep the WHOLE history.

spend.description: Canonical spend block for the Overview card — Total spent / Budget spent today / CPC each in three variants (total=committed, actual=billed, provisioned=holds; total = actual + provisioned), plus top sources. Present on the OVERVIEW response; null on the lensed (?lens=) response (lens pages use costPerConversionUsd); absent on grouped (?groupBy=campaignId) groups. (features-service#396, committed naming features-service#402)

date.description: UTC calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD) of the contacted-lead bucket.

count.description: Number of leads first contacted on this UTC day.

daily.description: Per-day contacted buckets (the Outreach ACTUAL series the daily graph renders), keyed by the UTC day of each lead's contactedAt, ascending. Complete series — one entry per day with ≥1 dated contacted lead; the dashboard slices its 7-day window from it. Sums to total - undatedCount. No wall-clock dependence (buckets come only from per-lead timestamps).

undatedCount.description: Contacted leads with a null contactedAt (cannot be bucketed — no synthesis). Counted in total but in no daily bucket, so total = sum(daily[].count) + undatedCount.

recipientsContacted.description: Server-computed contacted aggregates for the Overview Outreach card + daily graph, from the SAME leads[] snapshot (single source, dashboard renders only — features-service#371/#372).

Same shape + same date-gap caveat as `signups`: `total` real, `daily` empty / `undatedCount === total` until lead-service surfaces the conversion date. features-service#476.
