allOf.description: The offer's per-leg figures and verdict — the object its own /offers/:offerId/revenue read serves.

offers.description: One LEAN row per offer the brand sells, ascending by offerId (the consumer sorts a table its own way). Each row is the byte-same computation GET /offers/{offerId}/revenue makes for its total — same channel set, same campaign scope, same brand pricing, one engine pass — with only the bulk dropped (no leads[], no spend block, no series), so a table can poll it. An EMPTY array is a real answer distinct from the 404: campaign-service lists campaigns for this brand but none of them states an offer yet.

offerId.description: The `?offerId=` filter echoed; null = every offer of the brand.

salesFunnelId.description: The catalogue sales funnel id (`GET /internal/catalogue/sales-funnels` rows[].id).

name.description: The funnel campaign's name, as campaign-service serves it (`salesFunnelName`).

face.description: Path of the name's face SVG on this service (`GET /public/catalogue/faces/{name}.svg`).

status.description: campaign-service's status (`ongoing` | `stopped`), relayed.

type.description: The funnel's type (catalogue `type`). Null only with `copyUnavailableReason`.

triggerLabel.description: What starts a REACTIVE funnel, in customer words ("Positive replies"): the catalogue funnel's `triggerLabel`. Null on a proactive funnel.

typeLabel.description: The Campaigns table's Type column (owner 2026-10-11): "Daily" for a proactive funnel, `triggerLabel` for a reactive one. Null only with `copyUnavailableReason`.

anyOf.description: A REACTIVE funnel's first item (owner 2026-10-11): its trigger, in place of its trigger step.

name.description: The channel's display name ("Sales Cold Email Outreach").

runByUs.description: We run it; false = the customer's own team (a `Your Team` channel).

items.description: The path in reading order (owner 2026-10-11): a proactive funnel starts at Start (`key: "start"`), a reactive one with its TRIGGER (`kind: "trigger"`); then per leg the channel(s) working it, then the leg's next step, to Paid client. EVERY two steps have at least one channel between them. The sourcing leg (Start -> Lead found) lists the sources THIS campaign runs (several). Render the items joined by arrows; never parse an id.

fromStep.description: `start` on the first leg of a proactive funnel.

runByUs.description: At least one channel of the leg is ours.

channelSlug.description: The leg's one channel (owner 2026-10-11: one channel per leg, the sourcing leg included).

channels.description: The leg's channel, as a list of exactly one.

legs.description: The same path, one entry per leg, in order.

path.description: The funnel's PATH as structured data (owner 2026-10-11: the Campaigns table shows it under the name). Null only with `copyUnavailableReason`.

shortDescription.description: ONE short customer sentence of what we do in this campaign (owner 2026-10-14: the Campaigns table shows it under the name in place of `path`), e.g. "We email new buyers until they reply with interest." or "Our AI books meetings with buyers who reply with interest." At most 12 words, English, no dash, never a channel's display name; composed from the funnel's legs (the client's own team steps left out), never stored. Null only with `shortDescriptionUnavailableReason`.

shortDescriptionUnavailableReason.description: Why `shortDescription` is null: `sales_funnel_not_in_catalogue` (the funnel id is not in this service's catalogue, as `copyUnavailableReason`), `no_step_run_by_us` (the client's own team works every step of the funnel: nothing of ours to describe). Null when it is served.

copyUnavailableReason.description: Why `type`, `triggerLabel`, `typeLabel` and `path` are null: the funnel id is not in this service's catalogue (logged). Null when they are served.

units.description: The unit campaigns (one per pipe) the money is computed over, as campaign-service serves them.

investedUsd.description: $ Invested since inception: the COMMITTED spend of every unit together (= `costEconomics.committedCostUsd`). Every cost row belongs to one unit, so this is exactly the sum of the units' own `committedCostUsd` (each unit's `/features/{slug}/revenue?campaignId=` read), on the requested pricing basis.

roiMultiple.description: The funnel campaign's ROI (= `costEconomics.roiMultiple`) = the value it ADDS over its own spend (owner 2026-10-11): ONE engine pass over the units' people (deduped) and spend together, on the offer's terms, minus their value where it took them over (`takeoverStep`, `valueAdded`; $0 when it found them); never a sum or an average of unit ROIs. Null with a reason in `costEconomics.unmeasuredReason` (e.g. `maturing`: still learning), `headline.unpricedReason` (e.g. `no_funnel_wired`) or `moneyUnavailableReason`. Read `maturity` for the flash/mature pair and the verdict, as on a campaign row.

moneyUnavailableReason.description: `units_price_differently`: the units' channels price on two different funnel definitions, so no ROI can be one figure (investedUsd is still served). Null otherwise.

allOf.description: The funnel campaign's EXPECTED return (see ExpectedReturn): its own mature return (basis measured), else its OWN sales path (salesFunnelId = the combination key, its sourcing leg dropped: a path counts from Lead found) priced on named hypotheses. Never another funnel's figure: an own path that cannot be priced (a leads-only funnel: Start -> Lead found -> your team) is null with `unavailableReason: own_sales_path_unpriced`. roiMultiple and maturity are unchanged.

mode.description: `proactive` (the funnel starts at Lead found: its people are the leads it found, then the people its outreach unit worked) | `reactive` (it starts at another step: its people are the people its units were HANDED, lead-service follow-up ledger).

key.description: The catalogue step key (`lead_found`, `conversation`, `meeting_booked`...), or `contacted` / `delivered` for the two outreach rungs.

label.description: The step's customer label ("Positive reply"), the catalogue's own; "Contacted" / "Delivered" on the outreach rungs.

kind.description: `step` = a step of the campaign's path; `outreach` = a rung of its outreach between Lead found and the next step (Contacted, Delivered).

people.description: PEOPLE at this step since inception (never emails). Null only with `unmeasuredReason`.

rateToNextPct.description: People at the next step / people here x 100 (2 decimals), served so the page divides nothing. Null on the last step, when either side is unmeasured, or when nobody is here. Steps are counted independently, so a rate can exceed 100 (e.g. a sale recorded with no meeting).

unmeasuredReason.description: Why `people` is null: `step_not_counted` (no producer counts this step), `no_unit_performs_step` (an act step no unit of this campaign performs), `outcomes_unreadable`. Null when counted.

steps.description: Every step of the campaign's path (Start excluded) in reading order, in PEOPLE since inception, each with the rate to the next. Proactive: Lead found = the leads THIS campaign found = the larger of its sourcing unit's finds (lead-service `leads-found` `found`, per source campaign, never merged with a sibling funnel's source) and the people its outreach unit holds (it held every found lead before 2026-10-12). Then Contacted (`counts.contacted`) and Delivered (`people.delivered`: people an email reached), then each later step = lead-service's `bucket-counts` of its outreach units, merged by max (never a sum). A funnel with no outreach unit (a leads-only funnel: Start -> Lead found -> your team) contacts nobody: Contacted and Delivered are 0, later steps `step_not_counted`. Reactive: the first step = people handed; an act step (Booking call) = people the performing unit acted on (the call placed); every later step = handed people with an attributed outcome at that step.

funnel.description: WHAT IT PRODUCED (owner 2026-10-12): its people at each step of its path since inception, Lead found included (`steps[key=lead_found].people` = the leads it found), with the rate to the next step. Byte-for-byte the campaign page's `funnel` (`/brands/{brandId}/sales-funnel-campaigns/{id}/activity`). Null only with `funnelUnavailableReason`.

funnelUnavailableReason.description: Why `funnel` is null: the funnel id is unknown to the catalogue, a proactive campaign has no sourcing or outreach unit (nobody holds its people), or (campaigns table only) a producer did not answer (logged; the row's money is still served). Null when served.

totalPipelineUsd.description: Org-deduped expected pipeline. Null (with headline.unpricedReason) when nothing is priced: no funnel wired, or no priced funnel (an offer that states no lifetime revenue is priced on the fleet median, see headline.lifetimeRevenueSource).

unpricedReason.description: WHY totalPipelineUsd is null, null when it is priced. no_priced_funnel = the scope walks no priced funnel (no campaign leg, nothing ticked, or its offer terms could not be read); lifetime_revenue_not_stated = no lifetime revenue exists at all (the offer states none AND no offer in the fleet states one to take the median of; an unstated offer is otherwise priced on the fleet median, owner 2026-10-09); no_funnel_wired = the feature wires no funnel; no_channel = the brand runs no channel yet. Never an average: the brand-level sales economics are no input (owner 2026-10-05).

lifetimeRevenueUsd.description: The lifetime revenue per paying client this pipeline was priced on: the offer's own stated value, else the fleet median of every offer's stated lifetime revenue (owner 2026-10-09: every offer always has one, never 0). Present on the priced Overview body; absent/null when nothing is priced.

lifetimeRevenueSource.description: Where lifetimeRevenueUsd came from: offer_stated = the customer stated it on the offer; fleet_median = the offer states none, so the fleet median of stated offer lifetime revenues stands in (say 'fleet median', not 'you stated'). Absent/null when nothing is priced.

headline.description: The units' pipeline together and WHY it is unpriced when it is (`unpricedReason`, e.g. `no_funnel_wired`: a funnel whose units wire no funnel we price yet, like AI meeting booking), the block a campaign row serves. Null when the funnel campaign has no unit.

committedCostUsd.description: COMMITTED run spend for the brand (+ optional campaign), feature-scoped, in dollars (>= 0) — billed `actual` PLUS the open `provisioned` holds. THE spend basis: every money figure below divides by it, and it is byte the same total the `spend` block reports as totalSpentCents, so the ROI a campaign row shows and the 'Total spent' the Overview shows can never describe different money. This is the field a consumer renders as '$ Invested'. features-service serves EXACTLY ONE spend basis and it is COMMITTED (billed `actual` + the open `provisioned` holds). A split basis was a bug, not a tradeoff: while ROI rode billed-only and the `spend` block rode committed, one payload answered 'how much did this cost' two ways at once and a brand with a single campaign read $202 on its Overview beside $191 on its campaigns table. Do NOT reintroduce a second basis and do NOT add a parameter to pick one. (features-service#779)

actualCostUsd.description: Billed-only run spend for the same scope, in dollars (>= 0) — EXCLUDES the open provisioned holds. TRANSITIONAL AND REPORTED ONLY: it is kept populated (and still honestly billed-only, because a field whose name asserts 'actual' must never start carrying a committed value) so a consumer rendering money off this field has a gap-free path onto committedCostUsd. NOTHING divides by it any more — ROI, %CAC, cost per acquisition and cost per conversion all ride committedCostUsd. (features-service#396, naming features-service#402, single basis features-service#779)

costOfAcquisitionPct.description: (mature committed spend / mature pipeline) * 100 — the MATURE cohort, see maturityDays. Null when that pipeline is null or 0, or when unmeasuredReason is 'maturing'.

roiMultiple.description: mature pipeline / mature committed spend — the MATURE cohort, see maturityDays. Null when that spend is 0 or that pipeline is null; with unmeasuredReason 'maturing' when the scope spent but nothing it spent is mature yet. Never 0 in place of null.

costPerAcquisitionUsd.description: Cost of winning ONE customer, on COMMITTED spend, for the scope this body describes — present on EVERY response including the default un-lensed brand read (the brand Overview is not lensed; it is the whole brand, every funnel). = committedCostUsd / expected paying clients, where expected paying clients = totalPipelineUsd / lifetimeRevenueUsd. Equivalently (costOfAcquisitionPct / 100) x lifetimeRevenueUsd, i.e. lifetimeRevenueUsd / roiMultiple — the same statement as ROI and %CAC in a third unit, which is why it MATCHES the lensed costPerConversionUsd for the same scope rather than being a second opinion (the lens divides the same committed spend by the same expected-client count). Uses the brand's own declared-funnel-priced economics — the same economics that produced totalPipelineUsd. NULL, never 0, when the brand states no lifetime revenue (or it is 0), when the pipeline is null/0, or when no funnel is wired: null means 'we could not measure this', a 0 would mean 'a customer costs nothing'.

expectedConversions.description: LENS ONLY — expected conversion count = sum of per-lead conversion probability (decimal) across the lensed leads (totalPipelineUsd = expectedConversions × LTR). Present only on a lensed (?lens=) response; absent on the default/grouped responses.

costPerConversionUsd.description: LENS ONLY — the mature cohort's committed spend / its expected conversions (see maturityDays). Null when that count is 0 or the scope is maturing. Present only on a lensed (?lens=) response; absent on the default/grouped responses.

maturityDays.description: The MATURITY DELAY the ratios (roiMultiple, costOfAcquisitionPct, costPerAcquisitionUsd, costPerConversionUsd) were measured under. A campaign bought for a cold-email entry leg (start_to_website_visit, start_to_conversation) waits 21 days for its replies and visits (lib/maturity.ts); every other leg waits 0. The ratios divide the MATURE cohort only: the committed cost of runs STARTED before UTC midnight of today minus this many days, and the pipeline of the leads those runs SERVED (a lead served before it, on the run-start clock; their outcomes count whenever they happened; a lead with no serve date stated is in the cohort). committedCostUsd, actualCostUsd, the headline pipeline and every count keep the whole history. 0 when nothing in scope waits, in which case the ratios cover the whole scope. A scope mixing legs applies each campaign's own delay; this field states the longest.

unmeasuredReason.description: Why the ratios are null for a reason other than having nothing to divide. 'maturing' = the scope has spent, but none of that spend is older than maturityDays yet, so there is no mature cohort to measure — a young campaign, not a bad one. 'maturity_unknown' = campaign-service could not say which campaigns wait for their outcomes, so the mature cohort could not be separated (a degraded read, not a property of the scope). Null otherwise.

committedCostUsd.description: The committed spend (dollars) the ratios divide: the MATURE cohort's when maturityDays > 0 (runs old enough to have produced their outcomes), the whole scope's otherwise. Smaller than committedCostUsd by exactly the spend still maturing. Null under maturity_unknown.

totalPipelineUsd.description: The pipeline (dollars) the ratios divide: the mature cohort's (leads served before the cutoff, undated included) when maturityDays > 0, headline.totalPipelineUsd otherwise. Null under maturity_unknown or when there is no pipeline.

ratioBasis.description: THE TOTALS THE RATIOS DIVIDE, served so nobody inverts a ratio: roiMultiple = totalPipelineUsd / committedCostUsd; costOfAcquisitionPct = committedCostUsd / totalPipelineUsd × 100. Every cost per outcome on this body (spend.*Cents, outcomes.cpcCents/cpprCents, funnelSteps costPerReachCents, costPerOutcomeHistory) divides this same spend.

closedWonCount.description: Deals actually CLOSED WON in the same cohort the ratios divide, PRICED to our outreach (?cause=, default outreach) — the rule the pipeline's won rung follows. 0 is measured.

closedWonRevenueUsd.description: What those deals are worth: each at the amount stated on it, else the lifetime revenue a paying client is priced at.

roiMultiple.description: closedWonRevenueUsd / ratioBasis.committedCostUsd — the MEASURED return, beside the pipeline ROI and never instead of it. Null when that spend is 0 (maturing).

realizedReturn.description: THE MEASURED RETURN — revenue from deals actually closed won over the same matured spend the ROI divides. NULL when it cannot be measured on this read: no source of closed deals could be read, the legs are unknown, or the grain never computes it (lens, per-workflow, cross-org reads). Never a fabricated 0.

costEconomics.description: The full cost economics of the units together (the block a campaign row serves). Null when the funnel campaign has no unit.

allOf.description: Per-leg figures and the maturity verdict of the units together (the object a campaign row serves). Null when unreadable or no unit.

takeoverStep.description: Where this campaign took its people over (owner 2026-10-11, one formula for every campaign): the funnel's first step unless its own units produce it. Null = it found them (its sourcing units are inside it): its return is the engine's ordinary pipeline over its spend. A step (e.g. `conversation` for a campaign answering Positive replies): it is credited only the value it ADDS.

people.description: The people its units served or ACTED on (lead-service follow-up ledger).

valueNowUsd.description: Their value now, on the offer's terms (the revenue engine's own).

valueAtTakeoverUsd.description: Their value at the takeover step (same person, same stated value, holding only that step).

valueAddedUsd.description: valueNowUsd - valueAtTakeoverUsd: what `roiMultiple` divides by the spend (= headline.totalPipelineUsd here).

valueAdded.description: The value this campaign ADDED, when it took its people over at a step the engine values (a reactive campaign). Example: 2 meetings booked off positive replies, a meeting worth $400 and a reply $150: 2 x ($400 - $150) = $500; on $10 spent, 50x. Null when it found its people (takeoverStep null, or Lead found: a lead nobody engaged is worth $0 to the engine, so nothing is subtracted).

salesFunnelCampaigns.description: One row per sales funnel campaign, in campaign-service's order (newest first).

offerId.description: The `?offerId=` filter echoed; null = every offer of the brand.

fields.description: Echo of `?fields=copy`: the rows carry their copy only, no money.

salesFunnelId.description: The catalogue sales funnel id (`GET /internal/catalogue/sales-funnels` rows[].id).

name.description: The funnel campaign's name, as campaign-service serves it (`salesFunnelName`).

face.description: Path of the name's face SVG on this service (`GET /public/catalogue/faces/{name}.svg`).

status.description: campaign-service's status (`ongoing` | `stopped`), relayed.

type.description: The funnel's type (catalogue `type`). Null only with `copyUnavailableReason`.

triggerLabel.description: What starts a REACTIVE funnel, in customer words ("Positive replies"): the catalogue funnel's `triggerLabel`. Null on a proactive funnel.

typeLabel.description: The Campaigns table's Type column (owner 2026-10-11): "Daily" for a proactive funnel, `triggerLabel` for a reactive one. Null only with `copyUnavailableReason`.

shortDescription.description: ONE short customer sentence of what we do in this campaign (owner 2026-10-14: the Campaigns table shows it under the name in place of `path`), e.g. "We email new buyers until they reply with interest." or "Our AI books meetings with buyers who reply with interest." At most 12 words, English, no dash, never a channel's display name; composed from the funnel's legs (the client's own team steps left out), never stored. Null only with `shortDescriptionUnavailableReason`.

Null when it is served.

anyOf.description: A REACTIVE funnel's first item (owner 2026-10-11): its trigger, in place of its trigger step.

name.description: The channel's display name ("Sales Cold Email Outreach").

runByUs.description: We run it; false = the customer's own team (a `Your Team` channel).

items.description: The path in reading order (owner 2026-10-11): a proactive funnel starts at Start (`key: "start"`), a reactive one with its TRIGGER (`kind: "trigger"`); then per leg the channel(s) working it, then the leg's next step, to Paid client. EVERY two steps have at least one channel between them. The sourcing leg (Start -> Lead found) lists the sources THIS campaign runs (several). Render the items joined by arrows; never parse an id.

fromStep.description: `start` on the first leg of a proactive funnel.

runByUs.description: At least one channel of the leg is ours.

channelSlug.description: The leg's one channel (owner 2026-10-11: one channel per leg, the sourcing leg included).

channels.description: The leg's channel, as a list of exactly one.

legs.description: The same path, one entry per leg, in order.

path.description: The funnel's PATH as structured data (owner 2026-10-11: the Campaigns table shows it under the name). Null only with `copyUnavailableReason`.

units.description: The unit campaigns (one per pipe) the money is computed over, as campaign-service serves them.

since.description: Always since inception: a lived path is read over everyone ever reached, never a window.

leads.description: People x offers who lived exactly these steps, paid or not (one person on two offers counts once per offer, each on its own path).

paidClients.description: Of them, those who became a paid client that is OURS (the timeline says attributable).

notOurPaidClients.description: Of them, those who paid but not because of us (the customer's own channel, or nobody could tell): counted, never priced.

revenueUsd.description: Σ over our paid clients of the stated sale amount, else the offer's lifetime revenue (stated, else the fleet median). Null when a paid client has neither (unavailableReason paid_client_unpriced), never $0.

costUsd.description: This path's share of the spend: every campaign's committed spend split equally across the people x offers it acted on (entry spend shared across the people it reached, plus each later pipe's spend across the people it worked).

roi.description: revenueUsd / costUsd. Null while the path has no paid client (status learning), never a fake 0 or infinity.

rank.description: 1 = best: measured with an roi (desc), then measured without one, then learning (most paid clients, then most people).

salesPathId.description: The catalogue sales path this lived path IS (same id spelling).

name.description: The catalogue's name for it; null when the catalogue has not named it yet (never minted by this read).

funnels.description: Per sales funnel campaign, best return first, the no-funnel group last. Σ over funnels = the overall totals.

dailySource.description: `campaign_revenue`: this pipe's day-by-day series is its unit campaign's own revenue read (`GET /features/{featureSlug}/revenue?campaignId=`, e.g. cold email emails/spend per day). Null when `work.daily` is the series (or the pipe has none).

outcomes.description: Each call in exactly one bucket, adding up to `requested` (twillio-service's own: connected, acceptedNotConnected, answeredNotAccepted, noAnswer, busy, failed, canceled, inProgress).

billedMinutes.description: Minutes billed on the leg to the rep.

connectBilledMinutes.description: Minutes billed on the bridged leg to the prospect.

requested.description: Every call row recorded (twillio-service), whether or not Twilio accepted it.

placed.description: Calls Twilio accepted and dialled (a call SID issued). The calls PLACED.

accepted.description: Calls the rep ANSWERED and took (pressed 1). Subset of placed.

connected.description: Calls bridged to the prospect (the rep's second keypress): the BOOKING CALLS OBTAINED. Subset of accepted.

billedMinutes.description: Minutes billed on the leg to the rep.

connectBilledMinutes.description: Minutes billed on the bridged leg to the prospect.

day.description: UTC day the call was requested, YYYY-MM-DD.

daily.description: One entry per UTC day with at least one call, ascending; adds up to `totals`.

committedUsd.description: The pipe's committed spend since inception (runs-service, the requested `pricing` basis): the same figure its unit campaign's revenue read serves.

costPerPlacedCallUsd.description: committedUsd / totals.placed. Null with no call placed.

costPerConnectedCallUsd.description: committedUsd / totals.connected: the cost per BOOKING CALL obtained. Null with none obtained.

spendUnavailableReason.description: runs-service did not answer for this pipe (the calls stay served). Null when `spend` is served.

calls.description: A pipe producing the Booking call step (AI Instant Call): the calls it placed since inception (twillio-service's own counts: placed, answered/accepted, booking calls obtained = connected), per UTC day, and their cost (spend, cost per booking call). Null with `callsUnavailableReason`.

callsUnavailableReason.description: `pipe_places_no_calls`: the pipe does not produce the Booking call step. `calls_unreadable`: twillio-service did not answer for this campaign. Null when `calls` is served.

pipes.description: One per unit campaign (pipe), in campaign-service's order: what it did and produced since inception. Money (invested, ROI) per funnel campaign is `/brands/{brandId}/sales-funnel-campaigns`, per pipe the unit's own revenue read.

name.description: The campaign's name: report the campaign by it.

status.description: campaign-service's status: `ongoing` = running, `stopped` = paused.

requestedPipeCampaignId.description: Set when the id asked for was one pipe (unit campaign) of this campaign: the answer is the whole campaign's.

asOf.description: When the queue was read (a snapshot, not a period).

leadsAwaitingFirstEmail.description: Leads whose first email is written and queued in our email sender, not sent yet.

leadsWithFollowUpQueued.description: Leads already emailed whose next follow-up email is queued.

firstEmailsFrom.description: Earliest moment (ISO) the sending window opens for a lead awaiting its first email: the earliest it MAY go out, never a promise (mailbox capacity can push it later). Null when no lead awaits.

timezoneRule.description: `lead_local`: hours are each lead's own local business hours.

timezones.description: Leads awaiting their first email per timezone, earliest window first.

emailSendQueue.description: What waits in our email sender for this campaign's pipes, read from the sender (instantly-service) over every pipe of the campaign. Emails only: a pipe that writes by another channel queues nothing here. Null with emailSendQueueUnavailableReason.

asOf.description: When the schedule was read (a snapshot).

leads.description: People this campaign's writers scheduled a follow-up for, on any channel (email reply in their last thread, WhatsApp...), each once: due + upcoming.

due.description: Their time already came: they go out on the follow-up pipe's next pass.

nextAt.description: The earliest scheduled time still ahead (ISO), picked by the writer in the person's own working hours. Null when nothing is ahead.

date.description: UTC date YYYY-MM-DD

byDay.description: Upcoming people per UTC day over the next 31 days, earliest first.

laterThanHorizon.description: Upcoming people scheduled beyond those 31 days.

scheduledFollowups.description: What the campaign's writers scheduled on every channel, read from lead-service (each person's next follow-up date, as last stated by one of this campaign's pipes, plus its reactive follow-up queue). Null with scheduledFollowupsUnavailableReason.

leadsQueued.description: THE figure to state as queued: leads with something of ours waiting to go out, every channel (scheduledFollowups.leads + emailSendQueue leadsAwaitingFirstEmail + leadsWithFollowUpQueued). Null when a part is unreadable (never a sum missing a channel).

dueNow.description: Of them, follow-ups whose time already came: they go out on the next pass.

nextSendAt.description: The earliest planned send still ahead (ISO), any channel, in each lead's own working hours: the earliest, never a promise. Null when none is ahead.

nextSends.description: What waits to go out and when, every channel composed: read this to say how many leads are queued and when the next sends happen.

medianDays.description: The delay to state: median days from a lead's first email to its first positive reply, on `basis`. Null while learning.

basis.description: campaign: this campaign's own reply pipes, once they hold minSample measured replies. pipe_fleet: the same pipes (channel x leg) across every client, once THAT holds minSample. Null: nothing measurable yet.

learning.description: True while no population reaches minSample: say it is too early to tell, never a number.

medianDays.description: Median days from a lead's first email to its first positive reply (1 decimal).

averageDays.description: Average days, same population (1 decimal). Long tails pull it above the median: state the median.

sampleSize.description: Leads with a measured first positive reply after their first email.

campaign.description: This campaign's own figure, since inception (shown even below the bar).

medianDays.description: Median days from a lead's first email to its first positive reply (1 decimal).

averageDays.description: Average days, same population (1 decimal). Long tails pull it above the median: state the median.

sampleSize.description: Leads with a measured first positive reply after their first email.

pipeFleet.description: The same pipes across every client, since inception.

unavailableReason.description: Why medianDays is null. no_positive_reply_pipe: no pipe of this campaign ends on a positive reply.

timeToFirstPositiveReply.description: Measured time from the first email to the first positive reply, since inception. Never a default or another channel's delay.

endsOnPositiveReply.description: The pipe's leg ends on a positive reply: its sends feed timeToFirstPositiveReply.

status.description: used: the CRM took part in the measurement. Otherwise why not, and every rate is measured on our leads counting every outcome, exactly as before the CRM existed. unreadable: crm-service could not be read (logged loud).

totalContacts.description: Contacts in the brand's CRM, per crm-service. Null when not used.

lastSyncedAt.description: When the CRM was last synced. Null when not used.

crm.description: The brand's CRM in this measurement.

minMeasuredFromReached.description: The learning bar: leads needed on an arrow's FROM step before its measured rate is used (10, the fleet's learning bar).

contactedRecipients.description: Distinct leads this brand has contacted — the population every measured rate is read from.

fromStep.description: The FROM step in brand-service's own wording, so the arrow joins the brand-service leg-rate write. May differ from the public catalogue's label (brand-service 'Form filled' vs catalogue 'Form submitted'): join the catalogue on legKey or catalogueFromStep instead.

toStep.description: The TO step in brand-service's own wording. Same join rule as fromStep.

legKey.description: This leg's identity in the public catalogue (GET /public/channels legs[].legKey), so the two reads join on one token with no translation table. Null only for a leg the catalogue does not carry.

catalogueFromStep.description: The FROM step's label in the public catalogue (legs[].fromStep.label). Null when legKey is.

catalogueToStep.description: The TO step's label in the public catalogue (legs[].toStep.label). Null when legKey is.

effectiveRatePct.description: The rate every money figure (pipeline, ROI, CAC, projections) is priced on for this arrow, 0..100. Never null on a catalogue leg: the seeded per-leg default is the last source.

source.description: Which source effectiveRatePct is, in precedence order: measured on the brand's own leads (≥ minMeasuredFromReached on the FROM step), else what the brand stated by hand (brand-service brand-grain store), else `default`: the seeded per-leg industry benchmark (defaultRatePct), never the brand's own figure. Null only for a leg outside the catalogue that nothing prices.

unresolvedReason.description: Null on every catalogue leg (a default always exists). Kept for readers of the older contract.

basis.description: WHERE this leg was measured. crm: the brand's CRM directly evidences BOTH ends of the leg, so it is measured on the client's WHOLE CRM history (crm-service funnel reach, contactsAtOrBeyond(TO) / contactsAtOrBeyond(FROM)). our_leads: on this brand's leads. fromReached is the population either way, so a consumer can say 'measured on 251 contacts in your CRM' or 'measured on 26 of our leads'.

outcomesCounted.description: On our_leads, which outcomes the counts include: caused_by_our_outreach whenever the brand's CRM is available (crm.status used) — a leg only our outreach can observe is not credited with CRM outcomes our outreach did not cause; all otherwise (today's rule). Null on a crm-measured leg. Measurement only: what the ROI prices is unchanged.

fromReached.description: Distinct leads (basis our_leads) or CRM contacts (basis crm) that reached the arrow's FROM step — the population the rate is measured on. Null when that step is not counted by anything in the fleet, or its evidence was unreadable.

toReached.description: Of the fromReached leads, those who also reached the TO step (owner 2026-10-08: the numerator is a subset of the denominator, so toReached ≤ fromReached on the our_leads basis). A lead at TO who was never at FROM — booked off a positive reply on the website visit → meeting booked leg, or attended with no booked step recorded — is not counted. Same null rule.

toReachedThroughOtherLegs.description: Leads at the TO step NOT counted in toReached because they were never at the FROM step (they came through another leg, or their earlier step was not recorded). Null on the crm basis and whenever toReached is null.

ratePct.description: toReached / fromReached × 100 — the share of leads at FROM that went through this leg, byte-equal to funnelSteps.conversionFromPreviousPct for the rung on the same population. A measured 0 (nobody at FROM went on to TO) is a real rate and, once sufficient, the effective one. Null when either count is null or fromReached is 0.

sufficient.description: True exactly when fromReached ≥ minMeasuredFromReached, i.e. this measured rate is the effective one. The bar is on the DENOMINATOR, so an arrow truly at 0% still becomes measured.

gap.description: Why the measured rate is not the effective one; null when it is. to_exceeds_from: more leads at TO than FROM, so the ratio is no probability (never clamped). zero_not_conclusive: 0 leads at TO, on too few at FROM to rule out the next source's rate p (a measured 0% counts only once (1 - p)^FROM <= 5%, about 3 / p leads). brand_reports_no_meetings: TO is a meeting step and the brand never reported a meeting to us (MEETING-POPULATION-1018), so its count there is not a measure; meeting_reporting_unreadable: whether it reports could not be read, no zero is trusted.

manualRatePct.description: What the brand stated by hand for this arrow, or null when it has not.

ratePct.description: RETIRED 2026-10-14 (no brand is priced on, nor shown, other clients' rates): always null.

brandCount.description: RETIRED 2026-10-14: always 0. The block stays for readers that still parse it.

defaultRatePct.description: The seeded per-leg default (industry benchmark, 0..100], stated whether or not it is the effective source.

fromReached.description: Measured candidates: the people (or CRM contacts) at the FROM step. Null otherwise.

toReached.description: Measured candidates: of those, the people through the leg to the TO step ("28 of 43"). Null otherwise.

outcomesCounted.description: our_leads only: which outcomes the counts include. Null otherwise.

brandCount.description: Always null since the fleet median was retired (2026-10-14); kept for readers that parse it.

kept.description: True on exactly ONE candidate when the leg has a rate: the one the leg's rate uses (its ratePct equals the leg's).

notKeptReason.description: Null when kept. outranked: usable, but a source earlier in the precedence won. below_learning_bar: fewer than 10 people at FROM. to_exceeds_from: more at TO than FROM, no probability. zero_not_conclusive: 0 at TO, on too few at FROM to rule out the next source's rate p (kept only once (1 - p)^FROM <= 5%, about 3 / p people: 598 at 0.5%). too_few_brands: retired with the fleet median (2026-10-14), never served. crm_measures_this_leg: our leads' rate, shown beside the CRM, which is where this leg is measured.

legs.description: Every leg between two steps, once (the grain a rate lives at), including EVERY non-entry leg of the public catalogue (GET /public/channels legs[] with a fromStep), each with a non-null effectiveRatePct and its source (the seeded default at worst). Join to the catalogue on legKey.

lifetimeRevenueUsd.description: The client value every figure is priced on — the same LTR the brand's pipeline uses. Null at cold start.

perLeadExpectedValueUsd.description: Mean expected value over the PRICED (their group has a rate), non-expired contacted-only leads. Null when `unmeasuredReason` is set or no such lead exists.

totalExpectedValueUsd.description: Company-level total over the brand's contacted-only leads, on the pipeline's own rule: each organisation at its most valuable member, summed over organisations. It IS what these leads add to the brand's totalPipelineUsd (and so to ROI / cost of acquisition); expired and unpriced leads count 0.

unmeasuredReason.description: no_entry_rate = no (campaign × workflow) group has a priced rate on any entry route.

signal.description: The engine signal of the entry route (`clicked`, `positiveReply`).

step.description: The funnel step the route lands on.

legKey.description: The leg the route IS (`start_to_website_visit`, `start_to_conversation`): the workflow-projection ladder that prices it.

paidClientGivenStepPct.description: P(paid client | this step) — the pipeline engine's own ladder.

valueAtStepUsd.description: What a lead standing on this step is worth in the pipeline.

offerId.description: The campaign's offer (the ladder's `offerId`); null when it states none.

featureSlug.description: The campaign's channel (the ladder's feature); null when campaign-service does not list the campaign.

workflowSlug.description: The versioned workflow lead-service froze on the serve.

workflowDynastySlug.description: Its dynasty — the ladder row priced; null when the catalogue could not be read.

contacted.description: Contacted persons of the group (deduped; engaged, bounced and unsubscribed included: the spend bought them all).

committedSpentUsd.description: Committed (billed + open holds) NET spend runs recorded on (campaign, workflow); null when it recorded none.

costPerOutcomeUsd.description: The leg-keyed workflow-projection ladder's `resolved.costPerOutcomeUsd` (?leg=&offerId=&pricing=net, the brand row of this dynasty) — what /offers/{offerId}/sales-paths reads. Null with `unpricedReason`.

unpricedReason.description: Why this group has no rate on this route (e.g. `not_the_campaigns_leg` — a campaign's spend buys its own leg's outcome only —, `workflow_unmeasured_on_leg` — no evidence on the leg, an explore allowance is not a price —, `workflow_not_on_ladder`, `workflow_unpriced`, `no_spend_recorded`, `campaign_unknown`, a ladder refusal reason, `ladder_failed`). Never a fallback number.

entryRatePct.description: P(this step | contacted, group), 0..100 = min(100, 100 × costPerContactUsd ÷ costPerOutcomeUsd).

expectedOutcomes.description: contacted × P = spend ÷ cost per outcome (when not capped).

workflows.description: One row per (campaign × workflow) group of contacted persons: the rate each of its contacted-only leads is priced on. A campaign 100% on one workflow reproduces its sales path's ROI: total ÷ spend = value at step ÷ cost per outcome.

expiryDays.description: A contacted lead whose LAST email sent is older than this many days is worth 0. A lead not sent anything yet counts while pending, up to this many days after hand-off.

lastSentOnOrAfter.description: Leads whose last send is strictly before this instant have expired.

contactedOnly.description: Contacted leads with no conversion signal (no click, no reply, no meeting, no signup, no form, no sale) that did not bounce or unsubscribe.

engaged.description: Contacted leads that engaged — their value, if any, is the pipeline's.

cannotConvert.description: Contacted leads that bounced or unsubscribed.

expired.description: Contacted-only leads with no email sent in the last `expiryDays` days — valued at 0.

unattributed.description: Contacted-only leads served under no campaign or no workflow: no group, no value.

unpriced.description: Contacted-only leads whose group has no priced route: no value.

expectedValueUsd.description: The value this lead carries in the pipeline; 0 when expired; null when `unmeasuredReason` is set or its group has no priced route (unattributed / unpriced: the pipeline counts it 0).

expired.description: Last send older than `expiryDays` days (or, never sent, handed off longer ago than that).

leads.description: One page of contacted-only leads, ordered by lead id.

lifetimeRevenueUsd.description: The brand's value of a client — the same LTR the pipeline is priced on.

pricedCauses.description: The outcome causes the values are priced on: EVERY cause (`outreach`, `other`, `unstated`) — a deals board shows what a deal is worth to the customer, not our share of it. The all-cause pipeline is GET /brands/{brandId}/revenue?cause=outreach,other,unstated.

standing.description: lead-service's standing state the column shows (`sales_interest`, `customer`, `disqualified`, `opted_out`, `not_contacted`, `unresolved`, `contacted`, `engaged`).

valueUsd.description: Company-level value of the column: one organisation = one client = the MAX over its members in the column, organisations summed. Null exactly when `unvaluedReason` is set — never 0 for 'no value'.

unvaluedReason.description: Why the column states no value. `ruled_out` / `opted_out`: nothing to win going forward. `not_placed`: never contacted. `see_contacted_value`: GET /brands/{brandId}/contacted-value values that column. `no_economics` / `no_client_value`: the brand states nothing a value could be priced on.

basis.description: `expected_value` (Interested): each person at the byte-same expected value the engine prices them on, on every cause — the column is a SUBSET of the all-cause pipeline. `won_value` (Won): the amount a human stated on the sale (whoever caused it), else the brand's lifetime revenue per client.

unpricedLeadCount.description: People lead-service places in the column that this read's lead population did not hold yet (their card reads null).

zeroValueReason.description: Interested only: why the engine prices this card at exactly 0 — `ruled_out` (a human ruled it out, it went cold, or lead-service holds its Disqualified mark on the person: GET /orgs/leads/disqualifications), `step_not_priced` (the steps it reached are on no funnel the brand is priced on).
