get.description: THE AGENT CATALOGUE (owner 2026-10-10, "chat first"; model and formulas: lib/agent-catalogue.ts). An agent narrows a request level by level: Steps -> Sales Paths -> Channels -> Pipes -> Sales Funnels -> Workflows. Vocabulary: STEP = a stage; PIPE = one channel x one leg (was the per-(channel, leg) `campaignName`), id `<channel slug>|<leg key>`; SALES PATH = a chain of legs ending on Paid client, no channel, id = its leg keys joined by `+`; SALES FUNNEL = a sales path with one pipe per leg (was the named sales-path `combinationKey`, same id and name: a platform leg `<leg>@<slug>`, a leg the customer's team or nobody works bare). A path starts on an entry leg: from nothing, or from Lead found (an outbound channel works the lead a sourcing pipe Start -> Lead found found). Every list row is id + name + icon + one line + `costUsd` + `roi` + `roiBasis` + `status` (`measured` = every input a measured fleet outcome; `estimated` = a sales funnel or path whose cost per paying client uses a leg rate that is not measured (stated median, default, declared): never say measured; `learning` = no mature history, cost and roi null; `customer_time` = the customer's own team, no cost to us). Rows rank measured > estimated > customer_time > learning, then roi. Fleet grain, no identity: value(Paid client) = the fleet median offer lifetime revenue; value(step) = the best rated route to Paid client (fleet median of stated rates >= 5 brands, else the seeded default, else a declared rate); pipe cost = the best workflow's MATURE cost per outcome of the leg's step, roi = value(to step) / cost; funnel cost per paying client = sum of platform pipe costs x outcomes needed per paying client, roi = lifetime revenue / cost; path = its best funnel in that order; channel = its best measured pipe; step cost = the cheapest measured pipe producing it. `limit` default 10, max 25 (a page stays ~2k tokens). Id lists are comma-separated; a `+` in an id must be sent as %2B (an unencoded `+` read as a space is put back). Names are given on first sight (the rows a page shows) and on creation, sales funnels by what they do, in 2 or 3 plain words composed from their legs ("Cold Email Meetings", "Reply Booking"; owner 2026-10-16), pipes birds, sales paths rivers; never a name twice (a funnel whose candidates are all held is numbered, "Cold Email Meetings 2"), never a workflow dynasty word; a pipe or path family whose single words are all given continues with two words (its own adjective + a family word). Service-key only; a draft object (a declared leg not yet published) is listed with `draft: true`. A fresh process serves the last stored figures while it rebuilds; only a read with nothing ever stored waits on the build (up to 150 s, else 503 `catalogue_economics_not_computed_yet`).

200.description: List triggers: the entry doors a reactive campaign starts on (internal, api-key)

id.description: The trigger id a reactive pipe names (`triggerId`).

name.description: The trigger's label, unique (an outcome trigger is named by its outcome: 'Positive reply').

type.description: Owner 2026-10-15 (outcomes and triggers are two catalogues). `outcome`: '⚡ <outcome>' (⚡ = the trigger glyph, never in the name), fired the moment a person reaches `outcomeKey`, exactly one per outcome, named by that outcome's label. `condition`: computed by us (an outcome + a delay + 'still not' another, a polled source, an integration state such as a GitHub issue in prod).

outcomeKey.description: The outcome (`outcomes[].key`) an outcome trigger reports. Null on a condition trigger (its `fromStep` is only the step its rule starts from).

callable.description: An OUTSIDE caller (API / MCP / Copilot) may fire it through campaign-service's public trigger door. True on every outcome trigger; on a condition trigger ONLY for the closed legacy list (follow_up_due, email_pushed_via_api, follow_up_date_reached; parked C3/D). False on every other condition: what we compute ourselves (`delay`, `poll`, `github_issue_in_prod`), a fact our own services detect in data we hold (`whatsapp_number_given`, crm-service's phone watch), and the inline requests between our own services (`on_demand`, `lead_requested`). Our services keep the internal door for every declared trigger.

valueUsd.description: A trigger can carry a value (owner 2026-10-15): an outcome trigger's is its outcome's fleet value (`/internal/catalogue/steps` `valueUsd`). Null exactly when `valueUnavailableReason` is set.

valueUnavailableReason.description: Why `valueUsd` is null: `condition_trigger` (computed by us, no outcome of its own), `outcome_not_in_catalogue` (its outcome is missing from the step catalogue it was valued on), `no_route_to_paid_client` (no rated leg leads from its outcome to a paid client). Null when `valueUsd` is served.

eventIcon.description: The trigger type's own Phosphor icon (e.g. `thumbs-up`).

fromStep.description: The step a lead stands at when it fires; null when it is not a step (`on_demand`). NOT where a reactive pipe on it starts: a pipe on a trigger standing at Lead found starts at Start (`fromStep: null`, `start_to_<step>`); or head a sales funnel with the trigger over the pipes leaving this step (`POST /internal/catalogue/sales-funnels` `triggerId`).

firedBy.description: The service that detects the event.

pipeCount.description: Reactive pipes that name this trigger.

get.description: THE AGENT CATALOGUE (owner 2026-10-10, "chat first"; model and formulas: lib/agent-catalogue.ts). A path starts on an entry leg: from nothing, or from Lead found (an outbound channel works the lead a sourcing pipe Start -> Lead found found). Every list row is id + name + icon + one line + `costUsd` + `roi` + `roiBasis` + `status` (`measured` = every input a measured fleet outcome; `estimated` = a sales funnel or path whose cost per paying client uses a leg rate that is not measured (stated median, default, declared): never say measured; `learning` = no mature history, cost and roi null; `customer_time` = the customer's own team, no cost to us). Id lists are comma-separated; a `+` in an id must be sent as %2B (an unencoded `+` read as a space is put back). Service-key only; a draft object (a declared leg not yet published) is listed with `draft: true`. 200.description: List plays: a pipe x a strategy (internal, api-key)

id.description: The play id a sales funnel names: the bare pipe id for the default play, `<pipe id>~<strategy id>` for another (`POST /internal/catalogue/sales-funnels` takes either in `pipeIds`). In a funnel id the leg reads `<leg>@<channel slug>~<strategy id>`.

strategyDescription.description: The strategy's description: who the play finds or what it does, in one plain line (e.g. `People reachable by email (they have an email address).`). Null on a pipe cataloguing no play (`strategyId` null: every assigned workflow).

costUsd.description: Average fleet cost, in the unit `costPer` names. Null unless `status` is measured or estimated.

costPer.description: The unit of `costUsd` in words, on every row: `per <outcome step>` for a step, pipe, channel (its best pipe's step) or workflow (its pipe's step), e.g. `per positive reply`; `per paying client` for a sales path or funnel. Quote it with the figure. Null when `costUsd` is null.

roi.description: Average fleet return multiple. Null unless measured or estimated.

roiBasis.description: `estimated` when anything the ROI rests on is not a measured fleet outcome: every ROI today, since it divides a step value or a lifetime revenue that ends on the fleet median of STATED lifetime revenues. Null with no roi.

status.description: About the COST. `measured`: every input is a measured fleet outcome (a pipe's, step's, channel's or workflow's cost per outcome is the mature fleet figure). `estimated` (sales funnels and paths): the pipes' costs are measured but a leg RATE the cost per paying client uses is not (an industry default or a declared rate): never present it as measured. `learning`: no mature history, cost and roi null. `customer_time`: the customer's own team, no cost to us. Rows rank by this tier first (measured > estimated > customer_time > learning), then roi desc: a measured figure is never out-ranked by an estimate.

bestWorkflowSlug.description: The allowed workflow the figure rests on.

allowedWorkflowDynastySlugs.description: WHICH active workflows (dynasty slugs) the play may run, sorted. Null on a pipe cataloguing no play (every assigned workflow runs).

runnable.description: We run it today: published, and worked by the customer's own team or on a MANAGED channel (a workflow exists). An unmanaged channel is listed but campaign-service refuses its launch (409 `no_workflow`). A customer surface shows only `runnable` objects.

notRunnableReason.description: Why nothing runs it (null when `runnable`). post.summary: Catalogue a play on a pipe (internal, api-key)
post.description: THE AGENT CATALOGUE (owner 2026-10-10, "chat first"; model and formulas: lib/agent-catalogue.ts). An agent narrows a request level by level: Steps -> Sales Paths -> Channels -> Pipes -> Sales Funnels -> Workflows. Vocabulary: STEP = a stage; PIPE = one channel x one leg (was the per-(channel, leg) `campaignName`), id `<channel slug>|<leg key>`; SALES PATH = a chain of legs ending on Paid client, no channel, id = its leg keys joined by `+`; SALES FUNNEL = a sales path with one pipe per leg (was the named sales-path `combinationKey`, same id and name: a platform leg `<leg>@<slug>`, a leg the customer's team or nobody works bare). A path starts on an entry leg: from nothing, or from Lead found (an outbound channel works the lead a sourcing pipe Start -> Lead found found). Every list row is id + name + icon + one line + `costUsd` + `roi` + `roiBasis` + `status` (`measured` = every input a measured fleet outcome; `estimated` = a sales funnel or path whose cost per paying client uses a leg rate that is not measured (stated median, default, declared): never say measured; `learning` = no mature history, cost and roi null; `customer_time` = the customer's own team, no cost to us). Rows rank measured > estimated > customer_time > learning, then roi. Fleet grain, no identity: value(Paid client) = the fleet median offer lifetime revenue; value(step) = the best rated route to Paid client (fleet median of stated rates >= 5 brands, else the seeded default, else a declared rate); pipe cost = the best workflow's MATURE cost per outcome of the leg's step, roi = value(to step) / cost; funnel cost per paying client = sum of platform pipe costs x outcomes needed per paying client, roi = lifetime revenue / cost; path = its best funnel in that order; channel = its best measured pipe; step cost = the cheapest measured pipe producing it. `limit` default 10, max 25 (a page stays ~2k tokens). Id lists are comma-separated; a `+` in an id must be sent as %2B (an unencoded `+` read as a space is put back). Names are given on first sight (the rows a page shows) and on creation, sales funnels by what they do, in 2 or 3 plain words composed from their legs ("Cold Email Meetings", "Reply Booking"; owner 2026-10-16), pipes birds, sales paths rivers; never a name twice (a funnel whose candidates are all held is numbered, "Cold Email Meetings 2"), never a workflow dynasty word; a pipe or path family whose single words are all given continues with two words (its own adjective + a family word). Service-key only; a draft object (a declared leg not yet published) is listed with `draft: true`. A fresh process serves the last stored figures while it rebuilds; only a read with nothing ever stored waits on the build (up to 150 s, else 503 `catalogue_economics_not_computed_yet`). A pipe x a strategy, catalogued per pipe so its ROI compares across clients (never invented per campaign). The pipe must be a platform pipe (400 `pipe_not_ours`); a pipe that catalogues no play yet takes one too (its default play stays every assigned workflow, the new play narrows it). Idempotent: an existing play answers 200 `created: false`. A pipe's DEFAULT play is staff-only: PUT /internal/catalogue/pipes/{pipeId}/default-play.

post.summary: Retire a pipe created by mistake (internal, api-key, staff)
post.description: Takes a DECLARED pipe no campaign uses out of every catalogue read (pipes, sales paths and funnels built on it, the channel's legs); the row is kept (who created it, who retired it, why) and its name is never given to another pipe. Declaring the same leg again (`POST /internal/catalogue/pipes`) revives it under the same id and name. Refused, never forced: 409 `pipe_coded` (a pipe stated in code), `pipe_in_use` (any campaign of any org runs or ran it, stopped ones included), `pipe_in_sales_funnel` (a declared sales funnel names it); 502 `campaigns_unreadable` (the campaign read failed: nothing retired).

post.summary: Retire a sales funnel declared by mistake (internal, api-key, staff)
post.description: CATALOGUE-RETIRE-1016. Takes a DECLARED sales funnel no campaign of any org runs or ran out of every catalogue read (a trigger-headed funnel then lists nowhere); the row is kept (who declared it, who retired it, why). A funnel the pipes compose on their own (no trigger head) stays composable from its pipes: the answer says so (`stillComposable: true`). Declaring it again (`POST /internal/catalogue/sales-funnels`) revives it. Refused, never forced: 404 `sales_funnel_not_declared`; 409 `sales_funnel_in_use` (any campaign of any org, stopped ones included: delete a stopped campaign that never ran first, campaign-service `DELETE /sales-funnel-campaigns/{id}`); 502 `campaigns_unreadable` (nothing retired).

notRunnableDetail.description: The reason in one plain sentence an agent can relay.

total.description: Rows matching the filters (before `limit`).

trigger.description: A REACTIVE path/funnel starts with this trigger (unique slug, unique name; owner 2026-10-11): `line` reads it in place of the trigger step. Null on a proactive one (it starts at Start).

triggerLabel.description: A REACTIVE funnel: the customer label of what starts it (e.g. `Positive replies`), shown as a tag. Null on a proactive funnel.

type.description: `proactive` when at least one pipe is proactive (own budget, worked every tick), else `reactive`. A funnel HEADED by a trigger (id `trigger:<id>+...`, owner 2026-10-15) is always `reactive`: every pipe answers its trigger, proactive pipes included. Campaign-service and billing relay it; nobody re-grades pipe modes.

face.description: Path of the name's face SVG on this service (`GET /public/catalogue/faces/{name}.svg`).

line.description: Who works each leg, in order.

costUsd.description: Average fleet cost, in the unit `costPer` names. Null unless `status` is measured or estimated.

costPer.description: The unit of `costUsd` in words, on every row: `per <outcome step>` for a step, pipe, channel (its best pipe's step) or workflow (its pipe's step), e.g. `per positive reply`; `per paying client` for a sales path or funnel. Quote it with the figure. Null when `costUsd` is null.

roi.description: Average fleet return multiple. Null unless measured or estimated.

roiBasis.description: `estimated` when anything the ROI rests on is not a measured fleet outcome: every ROI today, since it divides a step value or a lifetime revenue that ends on the fleet median of STATED lifetime revenues. Null with no roi.

status.description: About the COST. `measured`: every input is a measured fleet outcome (a pipe's, step's, channel's or workflow's cost per outcome is the mature fleet figure). `estimated` (sales funnels and paths): the pipes' costs are measured but a leg RATE the cost per paying client uses is not (an industry default or a declared rate): never present it as measured. `learning`: no mature history, cost and roi null. `customer_time`: the customer's own team, no cost to us. Rows rank by this tier first (measured > estimated > customer_time > learning), then roi desc: a measured figure is never out-ranked by an estimate.
Always `expected`: an assumption-backed figure, never measured. Show it with an `expected` mark.

costUsd.description: Expected cost per paying client, USD.

costPer.description: `per paying client`; null when `costUsd` is null.

roi.description: Expected return multiple: (lifetime revenue - what the people it takes over were already worth) / expected cost per paying client.

basis.description: The WEAKEST input it rests on (measured < stated < fleet < default). Null with no figure.

unavailableReason.description: Why there is no figure: `no_lifetime_revenue`, `leg_unrated:<leg>`, `pipe_unpriced:<pipe id>`, `leg_without_pipe:<leg>`, `customer_time_only` (nothing of ours costs anything), `takeover_step_unvalued` (cost served, roi null). Null with a figure.

expected.description: EXPECTED economics (owner 2026-10-11: a ROI is never blank, an assumption if need be): the funnel formula where every missing input takes an assumption. Pipe cost: mature workflow > seeded default > market benchmark > its early flash figure > another channel's mature price on the same leg (the highest); the customer's team costs 0. Leg rate: the path's (brand measured / stated > default) > entry default. On a measured/estimated funnel it equals `costUsd`/`roi`.

runnable.description: We run it today: published, and worked by the customer's own team or on a MANAGED channel (a workflow exists). An unmanaged channel is listed but campaign-service refuses its launch (409 `no_workflow`). A customer surface shows only `runnable` objects.

mixed.description: A proactive pipe AND a reactive pipe we run (platform-operated) in one funnel: its budget caps both, so the reactive part can starve the proactive one (owner 2026-10-10). A mixed funnel is never `runnable`; propose a proactive funnel and a separate reactive one.

400.description: A query value the read does not recognise (`reason`).

get.summary: Every catalogue step's key, name and icon (public)
get.description: The step vocabulary with nothing economic, plus each step's place on the ONE lifecycle ladder (`lifecycleRung`, `lifecycleRank`, the ladder in `lifecycleLadder`; owner 2026-10-17, lead-service reads it for a lead's Lifecycle): one row per step of the agent catalogue, `key` = the canonical step key the fleet uses, `name` and `icon` (Phosphor) byte-equal to `GET /internal/catalogue/steps` `name`/`icon` for that step (a declared step states its own icon). No identity. Read by the customer dashboard's Outcomes entries (owner 2026-10-11). Sorted by key.

lifecycleLadder.description: The lifecycle ladder itself, lowest rung first.

key.description: Canonical step key (`lead_found`, `conversation`, ...).

pluralName.description: The name's plural for counts ('Leads', 'Positive replies').

lifecycleRung.description: The step's rung on the ONE lifecycle ladder (owner 2026-10-17, the same for every campaign, sales funnel, brand and channel): lead_found < contacted < engaged (post engaged, positive reply, website visit) < signup_or_form (Signup, Form submitted) < meeting_booked < meeting_attended < paid_client. `none` = on no rung, stated explicitly. Null = a step declared at run time that never stated one. A lead's Lifecycle = the highest rung of any step they reached.

lifecycleRank.description: The rung's rank, 1 (lead_found) to 7 (paid_client); higher = further. Null when `lifecycleRung` is `none` or null.
